recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core follow-up is needed for FHIR-7238 unless a future OO or FHIR-I decision intentionally revises the broader DiagnosticReport/Observation/QuestionnaireResponse boundary guidance.
issue_request: FHIR-7238 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification DSTU1 clarification asking for the difference between DiagnosticReport, Observation, and QuestionnaireAnswers. The resolution said DiagnosticReport boundaries had already been updated via the same-change-family FHIR-6199 work and that Questionnaire guidance had been updated to clarify that information may exist in multiple forms depending on purpose.
initial_application: No source commit explicitly mentioning FHIR-7238 was found. DiagnosticReport guidance appears to have been applied by 1a1a9868d5186613a0e3aa02a2676638d36968f8, which added the Boundaries and Relationships section under the FHIR-6199 application path. Questionnaire guidance appears to have been applied by cacb4626a33e26cbc231a2b66d1e53eb0ce31c4a, which added the multiple-forms paragraph using QuestionnaireAnswers terminology, then retained through c51b8682420300c0f51dd0ad260d0be7f5ae20ab and 52dbc1c47868e26651369ea4109008738f17ce5e after the QuestionnaireResponse rename and refactor.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively lists DiagnosticReport, Observation, Questionnaire, and QuestionnaireResponse. Current source includes DiagnosticReport-versus-Observation boundaries, Observation boundaries that reference DiagnosticReport and QuestionnaireResponse, Questionnaire guidance that the same information may be retained in QuestionnaireResponse and extracted into resources such as Observation, and QuestionnaireResponse boundaries contrasting form answers with Observation's clinical-answer focus. Recent combined-branch audits for FHIR-6313 and FHIR-7193 independently confirmed nearby QuestionnaireResponse and diagnostic boundary families. Bounded Zulip and Confluence searches found no directly relevant community record or later final decision that supersedes the current guidance.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit on the combined branch. The current FHIR core source already satisfies FHIR-7238, so adding more prose would be redundant and risk future drift.
